row.title: CONSTITUTION-1: the seed states what an ultrastable system is, as code
row.body: Rowan 2026-11-25: the core template must say what an ultrastable system is, how it runs, bootstraps, becomes autonomous and reaches criticality, so the owner never supplies it by chat. seed/doctrine/constitution.json is the statement; seed/scripts/constitution.py checks it against the tick steps, boot stages, ladder rungs, ignition stages and criticality conditions in code; each rule names a detector and a remediation that exist; bootstrap stage constitute assembles org/constitution.json; CLAUDE.md imports the generated prose; a standing rule with no entry fails CI. Remaining unmapped product-feature rules are a shrink-only baseline drained by Q-CONSTITUTION-DRAIN.
